reason: The remote-access refactor is moving these files onto a new layout; an edit made now cannot be carried across by git and has to be redone by hand.
howToEdit: R1-R2: the four door files. From R3, replace `paths` with the one family being moved (per run). A `paths` array that is empty, or no file at all, means no lock. A path ending in / locks a whole folder.
